title: Speed up planning hot paths with native extensions
desc: The main bottlenecks are the Python _bresenham_cells generator (shared by grid A* and RRT*) and _segment_cost in RRT* (called O(max_iter × neighbors) times), and the heapq loop in grid_astar. Recommended approach: (1) try @numba.njit on these inner loops first — zero build overhead, easy to toggle; (2) replace grid_astar with skimage.graph.route_through_array which is C-backed; (3) Cython or pybind11 only if numba is unacceptable for deployment. Full C/C++ rewrite is not justified given that numpy, cKDTree, and Shapely/GEOS are already native.

title: Elevation-aware planning costs
desc: Integrate DEM tiles and add a slope penalty term in PathGrid.fill so the planners avoid steep terrain, not just tagged obstacles.

title: Progress reporting for fetch_area via SocketIO
desc: The fetch task is polled over REST while a SocketIO channel already exists for telemetry; pushing the query, parse and save stages would remove the polling.

title: Obstacle nodes on ways are never obstacles
desc: parse_osm_nodes skips every node that belongs to a parsed way, so a barrier=bollard or barrier=gate on a footway (its usual OSM position) never blocks the planner. Decide whether barrier nodes on routable ways should become obstacles (or a traversability rule) instead.
